title: Differential channel compliance masks
description: Frequency/dB masks for Sdd11 (return loss), Sdd21 (insertion loss) and Sdc21 (mode conversion). A mask is a normative threshold and therefore carries its provenance: an entry whose status is not CONFIRM must name the standard, revision, section, locator and access date. Issue #53.

status.description: ACTIVE: sourced and usable as a gate. CONFIRM: the mask is not known yet; points MUST be empty and the gate reports NO_COVERAGE. FIXTURE: synthetic values for tests, never a compliance claim.

points.description: Breakpoints, ascending in hz. Between them the mask is linear in dB; outside them it says nothing.

$comment: ACTIVE with an empty points array is refused by the loader rather than by this schema: JSON Schema can express the shape but not the reason, and the reason is the part a reader needs.
